snippet.description:
Why does it feel so hard to start a family today? How much of that is truly a personal choice?

Subscribe to our channel! http://goo.gl/0bsAjO

In this episode of The Gray Area, guest host Christine Emba sits down with journalist Anna Louise Sussman to discuss her new book, Inconceivable: The Impossibility of Family in an Age of Uncertainty. Together, they look past the surface-level "cost of living" arguments to explore how economic volatility, climate anxiety, and the commodification of reproduction are reshaping the way millennials and Gen Z think about parenthood.

00:00 Intro
01:43 Generational uncertainty 
03:34 Empowerment of choosing to parent 
08:54 “Project me” and parenting
15:36 Structural infertility and climate anxieties
30:18 Financialization of fertility care
39:39 Is uncertainty pushing more people away from parenthood?

Guest Host Christine Emba, columnist and author
Guest: Anna Luise Sussman, author Inconceivable: The Impossibility of Family in an Age of Uncertainty

We would love to hear from you. To tell us what you thought of this episode, email us at thegrayarea@vox.com or leave us a voicemail at 1-800-214-5749. Your comments and questions help us make a better show.
